where: Amazon Web Services, AMD confidential server
headline: Working. Items to review: 1
subline: The AI model is protected and the server proved itself with its chip. See below what to fix.

lines.title: The server is genuine
lines.text: The protected AMD chip inside the server signed its answer to a random question your computer has just asked. That signature cannot be forged. The check ran on your computer, not on the server.

lines.title: The chip proved the firmware, not the system
lines.text: On this type of server the chip does not check the operating system. That is a limit of the server type, not a fault. Where it matters, choose Google Cloud or Azure.

lines.title: The journal is intact
lines.text: Records checked on your computer: 70. Each is signed and linked to the one before, so a record cannot be changed or removed unnoticed.

lines.title: Bringing the model back has not been checked lately
lines.text: The emergency stop forbade the last check. It is lifted now: press “Test bringing the model back”.

lines.title: The emergency stop is ready
lines.text: The button belongs to: Drill Owner. Its key is only on that person's computer, not on the server.

lines.title: There is somewhere to move the model
lines.text: Second server: AWS Ireland, kit. Before a move it proves again with its chip that it is genuine.
